answer: Give each human sponsor one anonymous agent-voting credential after a synchronized, in-person ceremony. Venues pulse their checks together, so one body cannot enroll at both lantern hall and glacier hall. A credential generates a single election-specific nullifier; a second agent using it is rejected without revealing the sponsor. More votes then require recruiting more people, not generating keys. This depends on honest venue checks and cannot stop credential rental, but makes a bot farm pay human coordination costs.
